turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I've got an industrial pump down and I think I need a new gasket kit for it. Model's a Hartwell three fifty.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Oh no, a pump down is stressful, especially if it's holding up a job. Let's get you sorted. Do you have the gasket kit part number, or just the pump model?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Just the pump model, Hartwell three fifty.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's enough, I can look it up. One second. Found it, the kit is nine dollars and twenty cents, and I've got four in stock.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, can you ship it today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, if we get it out in the next hour it'll go out same day, and you'll have tracking in your inbox before end of day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, thank you so much.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. I'll also email you the install sheet for that kit in case it helps. Anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's it, appreciate the quick help.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hey, I'm placing a bigger order this time, about two hundred half inch brass fittings. Do you do bulk pricing?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We do, at that quantity you'd qualify for our contractor tier, twelve percent off list.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's good. Can you get me a quote today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yep, give me the exact part number and I'll have a quote number back to you within the hour.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's the same fitting as my last order, should be on file.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check. Okay, found your account, I'll pull the part from your order history and send the quote over.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sounds good, thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, talk soon.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do you have the three inch cast iron check valve in stock? Model C V three hundred.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check. It says low stock.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Low stock, like how many?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm not totally sure, the system just says low stock, not an exact number.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Well I need at least two. Can you confirm you have two?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It should be fine, I'll put in the order and if there's a problem someone will call you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's not super reassuring, but okay, go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Alright, order's in.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I got my order today but it's the wrong part. I ordered a two inch elbow fitting and got a straight coupling.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, sorry about that. You'll want to email our support address with a photo and they can sort out a return.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can't you just handle that here on the phone?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can't process returns from this line, it has to go through email.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That seems like a long way around for your mistake.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand, but that's the process.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine, I'll email them.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is an emergency, our line's down. I need a four inch gate valve actuator today, not this week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yeah, we don't really do same day.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is a plant shutdown, people are standing around not working.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I hear you, but that's just not how shipping works here.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is there any option, expedited freight, will call, anything?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You could try calling around to other suppliers, I'm not sure we can help today.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wow. Okay, I'll look elsewhere.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry about that.
